events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents its All-Star Jazz Orchestra directed by Eric Miyashiro on August 17, 2026, with Peter Erskine and Mike Mainieri as special guests. Sets start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue explicitly links Erskine to Weather Report and Mainieri to Steps Ahead, and notes that Mainieri composed ‘Trains,’ which the orchestra and Erskine previously performed in a 2020 remote session.

provenance.note: Date, two set times, full orchestra lineup, special guests, Weather Report/Steps Ahead context and active web reservation status were verified on Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. Listening links are exact Apple Music album pages.

en.why_it_matters: This is a one-night convergence of two living fusion lineages with an unusually strong Japanese ensemble: Erskine brings the Weather Report drum language, Mainieri the vibraphone-centered Steps Ahead world, and Eric Miyashiro's orchestra adds players such as Masato Honda and Senri Kawaguchi. For Listening Notes, the appeal is less nostalgia than hearing those electric-jazz vocabularies refracted through a top-level Tokyo big band.
en.trip_verdict: A+ within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Prioritize one of the two sets if you are in Tokyo; the one-night format, special guests and fusion lineage make it a destination night, though not a transpacific trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Es una convergencia de una sola noche entre dos linajes vivos de la fusión y una orquesta japonesa de altísimo nivel: Erskine trae el lenguaje de batería de Weather Report, Mainieri el mundo de Steps Ahead centrado en el vibráfono, y la orquesta de Eric Miyashiro suma instrumentistas como Masato Honda y Senri Kawaguchi. Para Listening Notes, el atractivo no es la nostalgia sino escuchar esos vocabularios del jazz eléctrico refractados por una gran banda de Tokio.
es.trip_verdict: A+ dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Conviene priorizar uno de los dos sets si estás en Tokio; el formato de una sola noche, los invitados y el linaje de fusión lo vuelven una noche-destino, aunque por sí sola no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

en.why_it_matters: Acid Bath built an outsized heavy-music mythology from just two records and then disappeared in 1997. The current return is therefore not routine nostalgia: after roughly 28 years away, the band's sludge/doom/psychedelic language is physically back onstage, with the melodic fracture of Dax Riggs' writing set against the suffocating guitar vocabulary that made the records so singular. Pairing that comeback with Obituary in New York gives the night a real extreme-music lineage rather than the feel of a generic reunion booking.
en.trip_verdict: S. Protect the night. Worth a dedicated regional trip to New York if 1990s sludge, doom and extreme-music lineage matter to you. It stays below S+ because this is one stop in an ongoing reunion tour rather than a unique final show, premiere or one-night-only historical event.

es.why_it_matters: Acid Bath construyó una mitología enorme dentro de la música pesada con sólo dos discos y después desapareció en 1997. Por eso este regreso no es nostalgia rutinaria: después de casi 28 años fuera, vuelve físicamente al escenario ese lenguaje de sludge, doom y psicodelia, con la fractura melódica de Dax Riggs enfrentada al vocabulario de guitarras asfixiante que volvió tan singulares los discos. Emparejar ese regreso con Obituary en Nueva York le da a la noche un linaje real de música extrema, en lugar de sentirse como otra gira de reunión genérica.
es.trip_verdict: S. Hay que proteger la noche. Sí vale un viaje regional dedicado a Nueva York si importan el sludge de los noventa, el doom y el linaje de la música extrema. en.why_it_matters: This is not a routine legacy-act stop. The Residents are bringing the world of Eskimo, one of their defining late-1970s conceptual works, into the unusually close Blue Note Tokyo setting on their first Japan visit in nine years. The combination of album-specific staging, a half-century experimental multimedia lineage and an intimate room makes the live context itself the reason to care.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect a night for it if you are in the region; the Eskimo-specific presentation and nine-year Japan gap make it a strong Tokyo trip anchor, though not by itself a transpacific destination event.

events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents WEST ROAD BLUES BAND on September 30, 2026, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue identifies the group as a pioneering force in Japanese blues, formed in 1972 around members including Takashi Nagai and Junshi Yamagishi, and notes that the band helped drive Japan's 1970s blues boom after opening for B.B. King in Japan and recording from 1975 onward. After suspending activity following Shinji Shiotsugu's death in 2008, the group returned for its 50th-anniversary period in 2025. COTTON CLUB states that the September 30 date is the band's only performance of 2026, made possible by U.S.-based guitarist Junshi Yamagishi's temporary return to Japan.

en.why_it_matters: Jordan is not merely a famous guitarist: his two-handed touch approach makes harmony, bass motion and lead lines emerge from one instrument at once, giving him one of the most immediately identifiable instrumental languages in jazz. In Keystone Korner's small room, the point is the physical detail of that technique and the way he moves between straight-ahead jazz, pop/rock reinvention and open improvisation without reducing any of them to novelty.
en.trip_verdict: A regional/local. Consider one of the four sets and make the DMV-to-Baltimore drive if singular guitar language and virtuoso improvisation are the draw. It is not a destination trip by itself, but the small-room access to this particular instrumental voice merits consideration if the date fits.

es.why_it_matters: Jordan no es sólo un guitarrista famoso: su técnica de touch a dos manos hace que armonía, movimiento de bajo y líneas solistas salgan de un solo instrumento al mismo tiempo, y le da uno de los lenguajes instrumentales más reconocibles del jazz. En una sala pequeña como Keystone Korner, lo importante es escuchar el detalle físico de esa técnica y cómo pasa del jazz directo a la reinvención de rock/pop y a la improvisación abierta sin volver ninguna de esas cosas un truco.
es.trip_verdict: A regional/local. Vale considerar uno de los cuatro sets y vale manejar del DMV a Baltimore si el atractivo es un lenguaje de guitarra singular y la improvisación virtuosa. No es por sí solo un viaje destino, pero el acceso en sala pequeña a esta voz instrumental merece considerarse si la fecha cuadra.

events.factual_description: Strathmore presents Stanley Clarke and Hiromi featuring PUBLIQuartet on Thursday, April 8, 2027 at 8:00 PM in The Music Center at Strathmore. The program is billed as A Celebration of the Music of Chick Corea and Beyond, combining Corea compositions with new works inspired by his legacy. Strathmore highlights Clarke's long collaboration with Corea in Return to Forever, Hiromi's formative connection with Corea beginning when he invited her to perform with him in Tokyo at age 17, and PUBLIQuartet's blend of classical performance, improvisation and global influences.

en.why_it_matters: This is an unusually dense Listening Notes intersection: Stanley Clarke, one of fusion's defining bass voices and Chick Corea's Return to Forever partner, meets Hiromi, whose own relationship with Corea began in Tokyo, with PUBLIQuartet adding a chamber-improvisational layer. It is not a generic tribute but a meeting of two generations with direct musical relationships to Corea and sharply different instrumental identities.
en.trip_verdict: S+ in the DMV. Protect the night. The Clarke–Hiromi pairing, direct Chick Corea lineage and string-quartet setting make this rare enough to justify a dedicated regional trip to North Bethesda.

es.why_it_matters: Esta fecha concentra de manera extraordinaria varios ejes de Listening Notes: Stanley Clarke, una de las voces definitorias del bajo en la fusión y socio de Chick Corea en Return to Forever, se encuentra con Hiromi, cuya propia relación con Corea comenzó en Tokio, mientras PUBLIQuartet añade una capa camerística e improvisatoria. No es un homenaje genérico, sino el encuentro de dos generaciones con vínculos musicales directos con Corea e identidades instrumentales muy distintas.
es.trip_verdict: S+ en el DMV. Hay que proteger la noche. La combinación Clarke–Hiromi, el linaje directo de Chick Corea y el formato con cuarteto de cuerdas la vuelven suficientemente rara para justificar un viaje regional dedicado a North Bethesda.
